markdown.markdown: ::: hero ## Applied Virology \| Consumer Hygiene \| Predictive Modeling \| Risk Assessment \| Food Safety I am an applied food and environmental virologist and microbial risk scientist working in consumer hygiene R&D at Reckitt, with a focus on Lysol, Dettol, and other germ-protection products. My expertise spans infection prevention, food and environmental microbiology, sanitation and disinfection, and quantitative microbial risk assessment (QMRA). I combine experimental microbiology, predictive modeling, and data-driven risk assessment to develop practical strategies for pathogen control and support evidence-based product development and public health. Throughout my career, I have investigated how pathogens persist, transfer, and are inactivated across foods, water, environmental surfaces, and consumer-relevant settings. My research focuses on translating microbiological data into practical applications, including sanitation and process validation, disinfectant efficacy, and microbial risk management. I enjoy working at the interface of laboratory science, predictive modeling, and applied R&D, collaborating across disciplines to develop scientifically grounded solutions for consumer hygiene, infection prevention, food safety, and public health. ::: ## Experience Snapshot - R&D Sr. Scientist, Germ Protection Virology, Reckitt Benckiser (2026-present) - Assistant Professor, University of Florida (2018–2026) - Postdoctoral Researcher, North Carolina State University (2015–2018) - Research Assistant, Louisiana State University (2012–2015) - Research Assistant, University of Alaska Fairbanks (2009–2011) ## Core Areas of Expertise - Applied Virology, applied microbiology, and pathogen control - Sanitation validation and disinfectant efficacy - Predictive microbiology and quantitative modeling using R - Environmental monitoring and contamination control - Agricultural water safety and preventive controls - Thermal process validation and microbial inactivation - Quantitative microbial risk assessment (QMRA) ## Research and Technical Portfolio My research integrates experimental microbiology, predictive modeling, and risk assessment to address practical challenges in food safety, sanitation, and personal hygiene. Across laboratory, pilot-scale, and field studies, I develop science-based approaches that support product development, process validation, environmental monitoring, and risk-based public health decisions. → [View Research Projects](projects.html) ## Quick Links ::: quick-links GitHub Zenodo LinkedIn Google Scholar :::
